name: Kokudouou ~Doura II~
source:
Main character is the king of a small country sandwiched between two major countries opposing each other. After his father dies both countries try to impose their princess candidates. Main character does not want to anger any side, so he stales the time promising marriage to each side. But the day of taking decision grows near.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2018/12/vn-of-month-june-2000-age-maniax-isumi.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公是夹在两个敌对大国之间的小国之王。父亲去世后，两国都试图把各自的公主推为王后人选。主人公不愿激怒任何一方，只得分别以婚约敷衍，拖延时间。然而，必须作出决定的日子正日益临近。

[译自 [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2018/12/vn-of-month-june-2000-age-maniax-isumi.html]vndbreview[/url]]
